_about: Rare-skill subset for the Phase 4 graph-expansion eval. Each query's must-have skill is tagged on at most 2 of the 130 profiles in retrieval_eval.json (6 of 14 on none); relevance labels use the same archetype scheme (2 core, 1 adjacent). Labels are topical, written before running the eval.

queries.query: Native Android app for a field-service company: offline job lists, camera uploads and push notifications, written in Kotlin.
Orchestrate our nightly ELT jobs with Airflow: ingest from three SaaS APIs, load the warehouse, alert on failures.
Build an Express API for a booking platform: auth, availability search, webhooks to the payment provider.
Move slow report generation in our Python web app into Celery background workers with retries and progress tracking.
Write end-to-end Cypress tests for our checkout and signup flows and run them in CI on every pull request.
Review and implement the cryptography for an end-to-end encrypted messaging feature: key exchange, rotation, storage.
Model our product analytics in BigQuery: clean event tables, sessionization and a few core metric marts.
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines for build, test and deploy of five services to our container platform.
Maintain and extend a Flask backend: new REST endpoints, SQLAlchemy models and better test coverage.
Improve prompt engineering for our support assistant: evaluation set, prompt iterations and retrieval tweaks.
Build a small marketing site and dashboard in Svelte with charts and a design system.
Prepare our card payment flow for PCI DSS: tokenization, audit logging and evidence for the assessor.
Train a churn prediction model with scikit-learn on our customer data and ship a batch scoring job.
Optimize a C++ physics module in our game engine and profile frame-time spikes.
